title: Sagewatch v0.1.0
summary: Initial local release of a read-only Claude Teams and Codex subscription allowance monitor.
impact: Adds a complete Tauri 2 desktop widget with local provider adapters, safe normalized storage, accessible status UX, scheduled refresh, and threshold alerts.
tests: cargo test --offline: 12 passed, 1 intentionally ignored live test
reviewGateNote: Compass revalidation and Arbiter integration review passed after all findings were remediated.
capabilities: Displays multiple Claude Teams and Codex allowance windows without flattening provider semantics.
Uses already authenticated local clients and stores normalized snapshots only.
Shows explicit freshness, health, provenance, reset time, and honest unavailable states.
Restores preferences, schedules independent refreshes, enforces backoff, and emits deduplicated accessible alerts.
risksMitigated: No passwords, tokens, cookies, transcripts, or raw provider responses are retained.
Provider schema drift fails closed and one failing provider does not erase the other.
Claude status-line input is sanitized through a bounded allowlist before Rust ingestion.
Codex app-server execution uses fixed arguments, bounded output, timeouts, and a compatible-version gate.
notes: No remote, push, or PR was created.
Claude live-session verification remains a documented target-machine check.
Team-wide administrative analytics and rollout transcript fallback remain deferred.
